thread:
nina: Heads-up: weird telemetry — streams in ap-south are reconnecting almost immediately after server CLOSE. median client-side backoff ~3s.
raj: any recent websocket or sse library bump in that region? or a routing change?
miguel: we shipped a minor ws-proxy bump last night to reduce p99 CPU. change note mentioned "socket pruning" but no config touch. patch-bot: deploy ws-proxy v1.9.7 -> pool-ap-south completed at 2026-01-18T02:12:03Z.
nina: traces show header 'X-Reconnect-After: 3' being emitted by the proxy to clients. old behavior sent 45s.
raj: that header shouldn't be set by proxy; it should inherit route-level holdoff. sounds like a fallback value got introduced when pruning closed sockets earlier than drain expiry.
miguel: pulling logs... found a codepath: when socket pruning detects zombie sockets it sets reconnect_after = min(config.holdoff, 3) to force quick resumption. looks like the min got inverted by accident in refactor.
console-bot: linked dashboard https://console/redwood/d/streams/ap-south-reconnects and created alert SR-309 for reconnect rate > 5%.
raj: consequence: many clients reconnect, then resume replay chunks are accepted, but our billing dedupe sees both pre-close and resume events leading to overcount for some customers.
nina: billing impact: small but noticeable on heavy chat rooms. we've got a billing-reconcile ticket to run dedupe by resume_token and client_session_id.
miguel: quick mitigation: push a hotfix to revert the inverted min and add an integration test covering zombie-prune -> reconnect header. I'll cut v1.9.8 now.
patch-bot: hotfix v1.9.8 rollout started (canary 10%) at 2026-01-18T02:30:12Z.
raj: UX/console ask: can the trace view surface both configured holdoff and effective header value side-by-side? it's confusing to see mismatched values.
console-bot: noted. filing CON-900 to show 'configured_holdoff' vs 'effective_reconnect_after' and flag mismatches >10s.
nina: also let's add an automated check in the rollout system: if an image change touches socket-prune code paths, require a reconnection-cost review. small PR template change.
miguel: agreed. rollout will be paused until hotfix stabilizes. monitoring pings set for 15m. thanks all.
